title: Canonical dual Tate normalization of a supported Cartier orientation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring annihilated by a positive integer $N$, use constant coefficient sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and use the ordinary etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and the published signed finite Tate sheaves [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf]. The canonical signed Tate pullback is the generator-normalized roots pullback extended to tensor powers and duals. For a closed immersion $i:D\hookrightarrow X$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme], put $S=i_*A_D(-1)[0]$, using the closed direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. When $N$ is invertible on $X$ and $D$, define the sheaf pairing $A_X(1)\otimes i_*A_D(-1)\to i_*A_D$ to be the adjunction transpose of tensor pullback, normalized Tate transport, the closed counit and internal evaluation. Suppose the Cartier ideal of $i$ is invertible [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], and take a derived object $K$, a map $\iota:K\to A_X[0]$, and an isomorphism $P:S\simeq K[2]$. Say $P$ is Kummer-normalized if there exists the supported relative boundary class $\kappa\in\operatorname{Ext}^2(i_*A_D,A_X(1))$ satisfying [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary], such that its precomposition with the pairing equals the exact tensor-by-$A_X(1)$ image of the Ext class represented by $P\iota[2]$, followed by the right unitor. Tensoring with $A_X(1)$ is exact because the actual line has a tensor inverse. For a commuting divisor square, define closed dual-Tate exchange by the ordinary direct-image adjunction mate followed by the normalized negative Tate pullback. The square is not required to be Cartesian, so when its top arrow factors through a nonreduced pullback divisor this definition includes the specified reduction map.
